GSSyncedDirectory.doc: A cloud-synced directory for game-save data.

GSSyncedDirectoryState.doc: Represents the state and its associated properties of the directory

GSSyncStateConflicted.doc: The directory has conflicts with the cloud, which the game needs to resolve.

GSSyncStateError.doc: The directory is in error state and can’t be used.

GSSyncStateLocal.doc: The directory is local-only and not synced to iCloud.

GSSyncStateOffline.doc: The directory is available locally, but not fully synced because the device is offline.

GSSyncStateReady.doc: The directory is fully synced and ready to use.

GSSyncStateSyncing.doc: The directory is currently syncing and is not ready yet.

+openDirectoryForContainerIdentifier:.doc: Requests an instance of the game-save directory.

-close.doc: Closes the directory, and resumes syncing the directory to the cloud.

-finishSyncing:completionHandler:.doc: Waits for the directory sync to complete, showing the sync’s progress in a modal alert.

-finishSyncingWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Waits for the directory sync to complete, without showing any user interface.

-resolveConflictsWithVersion:.doc: Indicates that you resolved a conflict.

-triggerPendingUploadWithCompletionHandl.doc: Triggers an upload of the directory for any changes that were pending.

error.doc: The error preventing you from using the directory.

state.doc: Specifies the current state of the directory

url.doc: The URL of a directory to read and write game-save data in.

isLocal.doc: YES if the directory version is local; otherwise NO.

localizedNameOfSavingComputer.doc: The localized name of the device that saved this version.

modifiedDate.doc: The date that this version was last modified.

url.doc: The URL of a directory where you read and write game-save data.
